subject: Attention
source_sentence: The attention matrix A ∈ Rsq×sa is derived from the sentence matrices Sq and Sa by computing the pairwise Euclidean similarity between the word embeddings of Sq and the word embeddings of Sa.

subject: Features
source_sentence: The attention features are stacked on top of the sentence matrix, creating an order-3-tensor: S2q ∈ Rsq×d×2 for the question and S2a ∈ Rsa×d×2 for the answer candidate. These tensors are used as the input into the convolution layer, giving more weight to the relevant regions in the sentence.
